title: Case 10: The First Loop
subtitle: Someone looks directly at Asma and says: 'You've asked me this before.' For the first time, another person remembers.
loop_reset_text: The city clock stops. Every sound stretches into silence. Then Asma wakes before the first experiment again.

lab.name: Abandoned Research Lab
lab.description: Burned consoles and a shattered temporal-memory chamber mark where the first loop began.

archive.name: Underground Archive
archive.description: Project files reveal who funded the experiment and who ordered its safety limits removed.

clock.name: City Clock Tower
clock.description: The Stranger waits where every loop's clocks briefly agree.

vault.name: Police Evidence Vault
vault.description: Evidence from earlier cases shares the same impossible timing anomalies.

farid.name: Chief Farid
dialogue: I kept the old case sealed to protect you.
You were at the original lab incident.
I thought forgetting would save you.

contradiction.result: Farid concealed Asma's connection to the experiment but did not cause the temporal failure.

farid.asma_open: Watch Chief Farid. Do not decide too early. Ask one thing at a time and listen for what changes.
tells: Chief Farid answers quickly, but their eyes move toward the nearest exit.
This time Chief Farid reacts before you finish the question. They remember nothing, but the pattern changed.
Chief Farid tries to repeat the same wording. One detail is different.
farid.pressure_line: You should not know that part yet.
farid.shadow_reveal: Chief Farid changes route after the interview and briefly checks a place they never mentioned.

dialogue: You think breaking the loop saves everyone.
I have seen the timeline outside it.
I keep this running because someone dies when it ends.

timeline: T-18 min — Leila objects to unsafe test.
Present — The Stranger continues stabilizing the loop.
deduction_prompt: Who caused the original temporal disaster that trapped Asma and the city inside the repeating probability window?
truth: Viktor Malik caused the original disaster by forcing the experiment forward after its safety checks failed and ordering the probability governor bypassed. The Stranger did not create the loop, but later learned to sustain it because the restored timeline costs someone he refuses to lose. Asma finally understands both the cause and the prison.
partial: You expose Viktor's role but cannot prove how Asma became the one person who reliably remembers.
wrong: Your accusation explains neither the override order nor the missing governor. The city clock stops and the first loop begins again.

loop_reveals.2: Look at me. We already know Removed Probability Governor does not fit. This time, watch Viktor's Override Order before anyone knows we are suspicious.
loop_reveals.3: Something is repeating too precisely. We have Removed Probability Governor and Viktor's Override Order. Now we find the detail nobody expected us to remember.

action_beats.label: SEARCH THE SCENE WITH ASMA
action_beats.title: SCENE SEARCH
action_beats.text: Asma moves with you through the scene, checking what everyone else ignored. You compare positions, timing, and what looks slightly too deliberate.

action_beats.label: FOLLOW THE MOVEMENT YOU REMEMBER
action_beats.title: PURSUIT
action_beats.text: You move before the moment repeats. Asma follows your lead as you cut across the route you remember from the previous loop.

action_beats.label: TAKE COVER & HOLD POSITION
action_beats.title: TAKE COVER
action_beats.text: The situation turns dangerous. You and Asma take cover, wait for the opening, and move only when the evidence says the risk is worth it.

twist_hint: The obvious explanation for Case 10 is incomplete; one detail only makes sense after the loop repeats.
